assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
SilverBridge Advantage denied the claim for CPT 93229 under reason code CO-197
stating that the required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
this specific diagnostic procedure is necessary to evaluate the patient's documented symptoms
